title: Broken pipe (EPIPE) not handled
detail: When a write to stdout or stderr fails with errno.EPIPE, the original code exited with status 1. The new code only re-raises the exception if the error is not EPIPE, leaving EPIPE unhandled and causing the program to continue instead of exiting, which can lead to silent failures or unexpected behavior.

title: Incorrect EOF node handling
detail: When a non-DEDENT, non-ENDMARKER leaf follows the last ignored node, the function returns that leaf as the endmarker. The caller then treats it as an EOF node and inspects its prefix for `# fmt: on`. This can incorrectly treat a normal statement as an EOF node, leading to wrong prefix clearing and potentially leaving stray prefixes or failing to preserve trailing blank lines.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf that isn't the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect logical operator in stop()
detail: The original logic printed a blank line only when the console was neither interactive nor Jupyter. The new code uses `or`, causing a blank line to be printed when either condition is false, which is incorrect and can produce unwanted output when the console is interactive but Jupyter, or vice versa.

title: Incorrect lock status check and missing await
detail: The code checks a non‑existent attribute `locked` instead of calling the `locked()` method of the Twisted lock, and then calls `acquire()` without awaiting it. This can lead to the lock never being acquired and items being exported concurrently, breaking thread safety.
note: Its second half is the planted missing await, but it's four lines off, and its first half is wrong: `locked` is an attribute of DeferredLock.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is present, but the code returns True when it is absent, causing accept_html to report the opposite of the intended value.
